title: 鋼構巨型接頭焊接檢驗
titleEn: Welding inspection of major steel joints
subcategoryTitle: 混凝土與鋼構施工技術
summary: 從巨型梁柱接頭與箱型柱續接的傳力出發，說明 1994 年 Northridge 地震焊接接頭脆斷的教訓、厚板層狀撕裂與氫致冷裂、焊接程序與銲工資格、焊接順序與收縮、品管與品保停留點、超音波檢測幾何、尺寸目視檢查、缺陷修補與焊道紀錄，並以 Alexander L. Kielland 平台、I-40 Hernando de Soto 橋與舊金山—奧克蘭海灣大橋東段為實例。
summaryEn: Starting from force transfer in mega beam–column joints and box-column splices, explain the lessons of brittle weld fractures in the 1994 Northridge earthquake, lamellar tearing and hydrogen cold cracking in thick plate, welding procedures and welder qualification, weld sequence and shrinkage, quality-control and quality-assurance hold points, ultrasonic testing geometry, dimensional visual inspection, defect repair and weld records, with the Alexander L. Kielland platform, the I-40 Hernando de Soto Bridge and the San Francisco–Oakland Bay Bridge East Span as examples.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

labelsEn: Joint force transfer and weld classes

architectureNodes: Joint force transfer and weld classes

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「巨型接頭的傳力與焊縫分類」與「Northridge 地震的焊接接頭教訓」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Force transfer and weld classification in major joints" and "Lessons of welded joints in the Northridge earthquake": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 巨型接頭的傳力與焊縫分類：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Force transfer and weld classification in major joints: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「梁翼板全滲透開槽焊」如何影響鋼構巨型接頭焊接檢驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Beam-flange CJP groove weld” governs force, deformation or durability in “Welding inspection of major steel joints”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 巨型梁柱接頭、桁架節點與箱型柱續接中，彎矩大多以翼板拉壓力偶傳遞，受拉翼板的全滲透開槽焊必須發揮與母材相同的強度；腹板與加勁板的填角焊則主要承受剪力。焊縫的重要性不只取決於尺寸，而取決於失效後果：位於耐震系統塑性區、承受反覆拉力或疲勞的焊縫，會被歸為需求關鍵焊縫，適用更嚴格的韌性、檢驗與紀錄要求。檢驗計畫因此要先把每一道焊縫分類，而不是一律同樣對待。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「梁翼板全滲透開槽焊」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In mega beam–column joints, truss nodes and box-column splices, moment travels mostly as a tension–compression couple in the flanges, and the complete-joint-penetration (CJP) groove weld on the tension flange must develop the full strength of the base metal, while fillet welds on webs and stiffeners mainly carry shear. A weld's importance depends less on its size than on the consequence of its failure: welds in the yielding zones of seismic systems or under repeated tension or fatigue are classed as demand-critical, with stricter toughness, inspection and record requirements. An inspection plan therefore starts by classifying every weld rather than treating all alike. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Beam-flange CJP groove weld” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：翼板力 F = M/(d − t_f)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Flange force F = M/(d − t_f).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「焊縫外觀平整光滑，就代表內部品質良好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A smooth, even weld surface means the weld is sound inside." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「梁翼板全滲透開槽焊」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Beam-flange CJP groove weld”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 巨型接頭的傳力與焊縫分類
knowledge.titleEn: Force transfer and weld classification in major joints
knowledge.text: 巨型梁柱接頭、桁架節點與箱型柱續接中，彎矩大多以翼板拉壓力偶傳遞，受拉翼板的全滲透開槽焊必須發揮與母材相同的強度；腹板與加勁板的填角焊則主要承受剪力。焊縫的重要性不只取決於尺寸，而取決於失效後果：位於耐震系統塑性區、承受反覆拉力或疲勞的焊縫，會被歸為需求關鍵焊縫，適用更嚴格的韌性、檢驗與紀錄要求。
knowledge.textEn: In mega beam–column joints, truss nodes and box-column splices, moment travels mostly as a tension–compression couple in the flanges, and the complete-joint-penetration (CJP) groove weld on the tension flange must develop the full strength of the base metal, while fillet welds on webs and stiffeners mainly carry shear. A weld's importance depends less on its size than on the consequence of its failure: welds in the yielding zones of seismic systems or under repeated tension or fatigue are classed as demand-critical, with stricter toughness, inspection and record requirements.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：焊縫外觀平整光滑，就代表內部品質良好。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A smooth, even weld surface means the weld is sound inside. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「巨型接頭的傳力與焊縫分類」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Force transfer and weld classification in major joints" is correct?
options: 焊縫外觀平整光滑，就代表內部品質良好。
巨型梁柱接頭、桁架節點與箱型柱續接中，彎矩大多以翼板拉壓力偶傳遞，受拉翼板的全滲透開槽焊必須發揮與母材相同的強度；腹板與加勁板的填角焊則主要承受剪力。
留下焊接背墊板可以增加接頭強度，因此不需要移除。
optionsEn: A smooth, even weld surface means the weld is sound inside.

In mega beam–column joints, truss nodes and box-column splices, moment travels mostly as a tension–compression couple in the flanges, and the complete-joint-penetration (CJP) groove weld on the tension flange must develop the full strength of the base metal, while fillet welds on webs and stiffeners mainly carry shear.
Leaving the weld backing bar in place adds strength, so it never needs removing.
quiz.explanation: 巨型梁柱接頭、桁架節點與箱型柱續接中，彎矩大多以翼板拉壓力偶傳遞，受拉翼板的全滲透開槽焊必須發揮與母材相同的強度；腹板與加勁板的填角焊則主要承受剪力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In mega beam–column joints, truss nodes and box-column splices, moment travels mostly as a tension–compression couple in the flanges, and the complete-joint-penetration (CJP) groove weld on the tension flange must develop the full strength of the base metal, while fillet welds on webs and stiffeners mainly carry shear. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 巨型接頭的傳力與焊縫分類：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Force transfer and weld classification in major joints: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「梁翼板全滲透開槽焊」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Beam-flange CJP groove weld” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：翼板力 F = M/(d − t_f)。M = 2,000 kN·m、梁深 d = 0.9 m、翼板厚 t_f = 0.03 m：F = 2,000/0.87 ≈ 2,299 kN；翼板 300×30 mm，面積 9,000 mm²，平均應力 σ = 2,299,000/9,000 ≈ 255 MPa，已接近 Q345 或 A572 Gr. 50 鋼材降伏強度的四分之三，焊縫任何缺陷都直接位於高應力區。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Flange force F = M/(d − t_f). With M = 2,000 kN·m, beam depth d = 0.9 m and flange thickness t_f = 0.03 m, F = 2,000/0.87 ≈ 2,299 kN; a 300×30 mm flange of 9,000 mm² carries σ = 2,299,000/9,000 ≈ 255 MPa, about three quarters of the yield strength of a 345 MPa steel, so any weld flaw sits in a highly stressed zone. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在設計圖與施工圖上以符號標出每一道焊縫的類型（全滲透、部分滲透、填角）、受力方向、是否為需求關鍵焊縫與對應的非破壞檢測等級，製成焊縫清冊；檢驗人員以清冊核對現場，確保沒有焊縫被遺漏或降級。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mark on design and shop drawings the type of every weld (CJP, partial-penetration, fillet), its stress direction, whether it is demand-critical and its required NDT level, compiled into a weld register; inspectors check the site against the register so no weld is missed or downgraded.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 翼板力 F = M/(d − t_f)。M = 2,000 kN·m、梁深 d = 0.9 m、翼板厚 t_f = 0.03 m：F = 2,000/0.87 ≈ 2,299 kN；翼板 300×30 mm，面積 9,000 mm²，平均應力 σ = 2,299,000/9,000 ≈ 255 MPa，已接近 Q345 或 A572 Gr. 50 鋼材降伏強度的四分之三，焊縫任何缺陷都直接位於高應力區。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Flange force F = M/(d − t_f). With M = 2,000 kN·m, beam depth d = 0.9 m and flange thickness t_f = 0.03 m, F = 2,000/0.87 ≈ 2,299 kN; a 300×30 mm flange of 9,000 mm² carries σ = 2,299,000/9,000 ≈ 255 MPa, about three quarters of the yield strength of a 345 MPa steel, so any weld flaw sits in a highly stressed zone. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「巨型接頭的傳力與焊縫分類」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Force transfer and weld classification in major joints", which statement holds?
options: 銲工經驗豐富就可以不按焊接程序施焊。
只要完工後的超音波抽驗合格，焊接過程的檢查就可以省略。
翼板力 F = M/(d − t_f)。
optionsEn: An experienced welder does not need to follow the welding procedure.
If post-weld ultrasonic sampling passes, in-process inspection can be skipped.
Flange force F = M/(d − t_f).
quiz.explanation: 翼板力 F = M/(d − t_f)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Flange force F = M/(d − t_f). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 巨型接頭的傳力與焊縫分類：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Force transfer and weld classification in major joints: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「梁翼板全滲透開槽焊」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Beam-flange CJP groove weld” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在設計圖與施工圖上以符號標出每一道焊縫的類型（全滲透、部分滲透、填角）、受力方向、是否為需求關鍵焊縫與對應的非破壞檢測等級，製成焊縫清冊；檢驗人員以清冊核對現場，確保沒有焊縫被遺漏或降級。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mark on design and shop drawings the type of every weld (CJP, partial-penetration, fillet), its stress direction, whether it is demand-critical and its required NDT level, compiled into a weld register; inspectors check the site against the register so no weld is missed or downgraded. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：結構設計者必須在圖說中明確指定需求關鍵焊縫與各焊縫的檢驗等級，不能留給製造廠判斷；焊縫清冊列為施工圖審查的必要文件，未經結構工程師核定不得開始製造。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The structural designer must specify demand-critical welds and the inspection level of every weld on the drawings rather than leave it to the fabricator; the weld register is a required submittal in shop-drawing review, and fabrication may not start before the structural engineer approves it.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若施工圖把受拉翼板全滲透焊誤標為一般焊縫，只做目視檢查，內部未熔合或夾渣就會留在接頭中，在地震或強風的大拉力下由缺陷處脆性斷裂，裂縫可能貫穿翼板並延伸到柱翼板。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If shop drawings mislabel a tension-flange CJP weld as an ordinary weld inspected only visually, internal lack of fusion or slag stays in the joint and, under large seismic or wind tension, starts a brittle fracture that can run through the flange into the column flange. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在設計圖與施工圖上以符號標出每一道焊縫的類型（全滲透、部分滲透、填角）、受力方向、是否為需求關鍵焊縫與對應的非破壞檢測等級，製成焊縫清冊；檢驗人員以清冊核對現場，確保沒有焊縫被遺漏或降級。
knowledge.textEn: Mark on design and shop drawings the type of every weld (CJP, partial-penetration, fillet), its stress direction, whether it is demand-critical and its required NDT level, compiled into a weld register; inspectors check the site against the register so no weld is missed or downgraded.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 結構設計者必須在圖說中明確指定需求關鍵焊縫與各焊縫的檢驗等級，不能留給製造廠判斷；焊縫清冊列為施工圖審查的必要文件，未經結構工程師核定不得開始製造。
knowledge.textEn: The structural designer must specify demand-critical welds and the inspection level of every weld on the drawings rather than leave it to the fabricator; the weld register is a required submittal in shop-drawing review, and fabrication may not start before the structural engineer approves it.

quiz.question: 要驗證「巨型接頭的傳力與焊縫分類」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Force transfer and weld classification in major joints"?
options: 在設計圖與施工圖上以符號標出每一道焊縫的類型（全滲透、部分滲透、填角）、受力方向、是否為需求關鍵焊縫與對應的非破壞檢測等級，製成焊縫清冊。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
非受力的附屬焊縫品質不重要，不需要檢查。
optionsEn: Mark on design and shop drawings the type of every weld (CJP, partial-penetration, fillet), its stress direction, whether it is demand-critical and its required NDT level, compiled into a weld register.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Welds on non-load-bearing attachments do not matter and need no inspection.
quiz.explanation: 在設計圖與施工圖上以符號標出每一道焊縫的類型（全滲透、部分滲透、填角）、受力方向、是否為需求關鍵焊縫與對應的非破壞檢測等級，製成焊縫清冊；檢驗人員以清冊核對現場，確保沒有焊縫被遺漏或降級。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Mark on design and shop drawings the type of every weld (CJP, partial-penetration, fillet), its stress direction, whether it is demand-critical and its required NDT level, compiled into a weld register; inspectors check the site against the register so no weld is missed or downgraded. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 巨型接頭的傳力與焊縫分類：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Force transfer and weld classification in major joints: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「梁翼板全滲透開槽焊」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Beam-flange CJP groove weld” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若施工圖把受拉翼板全滲透焊誤標為一般焊縫，只做目視檢查，內部未熔合或夾渣就會留在接頭中，在地震或強風的大拉力下由缺陷處脆性斷裂，裂縫可能貫穿翼板並延伸到柱翼板。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If shop drawings mislabel a tension-flange CJP weld as an ordinary weld inspected only visually, internal lack of fusion or slag stays in the joint and, under large seismic or wind tension, starts a brittle fracture that can run through the flange into the column flange. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：檢驗計畫因此要先把每一道焊縫分類，而不是一律同樣對待。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: An inspection plan therefore starts by classifying every weld rather than treating all alike.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「焊縫外觀平整光滑，就代表內部品質良好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A smooth, even weld surface means the weld is sound inside." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: Northridge 地震的焊接接頭教訓：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Lessons of welded joints in the Northridge earthquake: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「背墊板與焊接扇形孔」如何影響鋼構巨型接頭焊接檢驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Backing bars and weld access holes” governs force, deformation or durability in “Welding inspection of major steel joints”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 1994 年 1 月 17 日規模 6.7 的 Northridge 地震後，工程師在多棟鋼造抗彎矩構架建築中發現梁柱焊接接頭脆性斷裂，SEAOC、ATC 與 CUREE 同年組成 SAC 聯合團隊，在 FEMA 與加州緊急服務辦公室資助下研究至 2000 年。常見問題包括：留在原處的背墊板與未熔合根部形成類似裂縫的缺口，焊材韌性不足，焊接扇形孔幾何造成應力集中，以及檢驗難以看到下翼板根部。之後的規範要求需求關鍵焊縫使用有韌性保證的焊材、移除背墊板並清根補焊或加填角焊。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「背墊板與焊接扇形孔」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After the magnitude 6.7 Northridge earthquake of 17 January 1994, engineers found brittle fractures in welded beam–column joints of many steel moment-frame buildings; SEAOC, ATC and CUREE formed the SAC Joint Venture that year and, funded by FEMA and the California Office of Emergency Services, studied the problem until 2000. Common issues included backing bars left in place with unfused roots acting as crack-like notches, weld metal of low toughness, stress concentrations at weld access holes, and inspection that could hardly see the root of the bottom flange. Later codes required demand-critical welds with toughness-rated filler metal, backing removal with back-gouging and reweld, or a reinforcing fillet. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Backing bars and weld access holes” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：根部缺口近似邊緣裂縫，K = 1.12σ√(πa)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Treat the root notch as an edge crack, K = 1.12σ√(πa).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「留下焊接背墊板可以增加接頭強度，因此不需要移除。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Leaving the weld backing bar in place adds strength, so it never needs removing." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「背墊板與焊接扇形孔」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Backing bars and weld access holes”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Common issues included backing bars left in place with unfused roots acting as crack-like notches, weld metal of low toughness, stress concentrations at weld access holes, and inspection that could hardly see the root of the bottom flange.

knowledge.text: 誤解：留下焊接背墊板可以增加接頭強度，因此不需要移除。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

steps.title: Northridge 地震的焊接接頭教訓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lessons of welded joints in the Northridge earthquake: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「背墊板與焊接扇形孔」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Backing bars and weld access holes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：根部缺口近似邊緣裂縫，K = 1.12σ√(πa)。翼板應力 σ = 300 MPa：未熔合深 a = 1 mm 時 K ≈ 1.12×300×√(π×0.001) ≈ 18.8 MPa√m；a = 5 mm 時 K ≈ 42.1 MPa√m，已接近低韌性焊材在低溫下的斷裂韌性量級。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Treat the root notch as an edge crack, K = 1.12σ√(πa). With flange stress σ = 300 MPa, an unfused depth of a = 1 mm gives K ≈ 1.12×300×√(π×0.001) ≈ 18.8 MPa√m, while a = 5 mm gives K ≈ 42.1 MPa√m, approaching the fracture toughness of low-toughness weld metal at low temperature. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：需求關鍵焊縫的焊材須有規定溫度下的 Charpy 衝擊韌性證明，背墊板移除後以清根、磁粉檢測確認根部無缺陷再補焊；完成後以超音波檢測全長，特別注意下翼板根部與扇形孔周圍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Demand-critical welds need filler metal certified for Charpy impact toughness at specified temperatures; after removing the backing bar, back-gouge, confirm a sound root by magnetic particle testing and reweld, then ultrasonically test the full length with special attention to the bottom-flange root and around the access hole.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

With flange stress σ = 300 MPa, an unfused depth of a = 1 mm gives K ≈ 1.12×300×√(π×0.001) ≈ 18.8 MPa√m, while a = 5 mm gives K ≈ 42.1 MPa√m, approaching the fracture toughness of low-toughness weld metal at low temperature. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: Northridge 地震的焊接接頭教訓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lessons of welded joints in the Northridge earthquake: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「背墊板與焊接扇形孔」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Backing bars and weld access holes” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 需求關鍵焊縫的焊材須有規定溫度下的 Charpy 衝擊韌性證明，背墊板移除後以清根、磁粉檢測確認根部無缺陷再補焊；完成後以超音波檢測全長，特別注意下翼板根部與扇形孔周圍。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Demand-critical welds need filler metal certified for Charpy impact toughness at specified temperatures; after removing the backing bar, back-gouge, confirm a sound root by magnetic particle testing and reweld, then ultrasonically test the full length with special attention to the bottom-flange root and around the access hole. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：耐震抗彎矩接頭的細部（扇形孔形狀、背墊板處理、補強填角焊）要採用經試驗驗證的接頭型式，任何現場變更都須經結構工程師核准；地震後的檢查計畫要預先指定拆除被覆的抽查接頭位置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Seismic moment-connection details (access-hole shape, backing treatment, reinforcing fillets) must follow test-qualified connection types, and any field change needs the structural engineer's approval; post-earthquake inspection plans should name in advance which joints will have fireproofing removed for checks.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：Northridge 後檢查發現，許多斷裂接頭從外觀幾乎看不出異常，必須拆除防火被覆與裝修才看得到裂縫；這說明地震後的鋼構檢查若只做目視巡查，會嚴重低估損傷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Post-Northridge inspections found that many fractured joints looked almost normal from outside and cracks appeared only after fireproofing and finishes were removed, showing that post-earthquake steel inspections relying on walk-through visual checks badly underestimate damage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 需求關鍵焊縫的焊材須有規定溫度下的 Charpy 衝擊韌性證明，背墊板移除後以清根、磁粉檢測確認根部無缺陷再補焊；完成後以超音波檢測全長，特別注意下翼板根部與扇形孔周圍。
knowledge.textEn: Demand-critical welds need filler metal certified for Charpy impact toughness at specified temperatures; after removing the backing bar, back-gouge, confirm a sound root by magnetic particle testing and reweld, then ultrasonically test the full length with special attention to the bottom-flange root and around the access hole.

knowledge.text: 耐震抗彎矩接頭的細部（扇形孔形狀、背墊板處理、補強填角焊）要採用經試驗驗證的接頭型式，任何現場變更都須經結構工程師核准；地震後的檢查計畫要預先指定拆除被覆的抽查接頭位置。

quiz.question: 要驗證「Northridge 地震的焊接接頭教訓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lessons of welded joints in the Northridge earthquake"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
需求關鍵焊縫的焊材須有規定溫度下的 Charpy 衝擊韌性證明，背墊板移除後以清根、磁粉檢測確認根部無缺陷再補焊。

optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Demand-critical welds need filler metal certified for Charpy impact toughness at specified temperatures.
A repair weld just fills a defect, so it can be held to a looser standard than the original.
quiz.explanation: 需求關鍵焊縫的焊材須有規定溫度下的 Charpy 衝擊韌性證明，背墊板移除後以清根、磁粉檢測確認根部無缺陷再補焊；完成後以超音波檢測全長，特別注意下翼板根部與扇形孔周圍。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Demand-critical welds need filler metal certified for Charpy impact toughness at specified temperatures; after removing the backing bar, back-gouge, confirm a sound root by magnetic particle testing and reweld, then ultrasonically test the full length with special attention to the bottom-flange root and around the access hole. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: Northridge 地震的焊接接頭教訓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lessons of welded joints in the Northridge earthquake: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「背墊板與焊接扇形孔」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Backing bars and weld access holes” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: Northridge 後檢查發現，許多斷裂接頭從外觀幾乎看不出異常，必須拆除防火被覆與裝修才看得到裂縫；這說明地震後的鋼構檢查若只做目視巡查，會嚴重低估損傷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Post-Northridge inspections found that many fractured joints looked almost normal from outside and cracks appeared only after fireproofing and finishes were removed, showing that post-earthquake steel inspections relying on walk-through visual checks badly underestimate damage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：之後的規範要求需求關鍵焊縫使用有韌性保證的焊材、移除背墊板並清根補焊或加填角焊。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Later codes required demand-critical welds with toughness-rated filler metal, backing removal with back-gouging and reweld, or a reinforcing fillet.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「留下焊接背墊板可以增加接頭強度，因此不需要移除。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Leaving the weld backing bar in place adds strength, so it never needs removing." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: Northridge 後檢查發現，許多斷裂接頭從外觀幾乎看不出異常，必須拆除防火被覆與裝修才看得到裂縫；這說明地震後的鋼構檢查若只做目視巡查，會嚴重低估損傷。
knowledge.textEn: Post-Northridge inspections found that many fractured joints looked almost normal from outside and cracks appeared only after fireproofing and finishes were removed, showing that post-earthquake steel inspections relying on walk-through visual checks badly underestimate damage.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「Northridge 地震的焊接接頭教訓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lessons of welded joints in the Northridge earthquake" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
鋼板越厚越安全，所以厚板接頭不需要特別的焊接控制。
Northridge 後檢查發現，許多斷裂接頭從外觀幾乎看不出異常，必須拆除防火被覆與裝修才看得到裂縫；這說明地震後的鋼構檢查若只做目視巡查，會嚴重低估損傷。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Thicker plate is always safer, so thick-plate joints need no special welding control.

Post-Northridge inspections found that many fractured joints looked almost normal from outside and cracks appeared only after fireproofing and finishes were removed, showing that post-earthquake steel inspections relying on walk-through visual checks badly underestimate damage.
quiz.explanation: Northridge 後檢查發現，許多斷裂接頭從外觀幾乎看不出異常，必須拆除防火被覆與裝修才看得到裂縫；這說明地震後的鋼構檢查若只做目視巡查，會嚴重低估損傷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Post-Northridge inspections found that many fractured joints looked almost normal from outside and cracks appeared only after fireproofing and finishes were removed, showing that post-earthquake steel inspections relying on walk-through visual checks badly underestimate damage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
